title: Fair Voting Methods as a Catalyst for Democratic Resilience: A Trilogy on Legitimacy, Impact and AI Safeguarding

bias_targets.methodology: Constructing over 50,000 AI voting personas using large language models based on real-world voter profiles to simulate the choices of abstained voters, and evaluating the consistency between human voter choices and AI representative estimates to identify inconsistencies and cognitive biases under different voting aggregation methods.
